name: com.foursquare.android.nativeoauth.FoursquareOAuthWebviewActivity
description: Foursquare's OAuth SDK opens this browser-based sign-in screen when the Foursquare app cannot handle authorization. It loads Foursquare's sign-in page so you can connect your account.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Foursquare account linking from completing when browser sign-in is needed.
